# paperclip_user_instance_access (Resource)

Manages combined instance administration status and company access for a user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "paperclip_user_instance_access" "operator_access" {
  user_id           = data.paperclip_user.operator.id
  is_instance_admin = true
  company_ids       = [paperclip_company.acme.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) User identifier whose instance and company access is managed.

### Optional

- `company_ids` (List of String) List of company IDs the user has access to.
- `is_instance_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is an instance administrator (defaults to false).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Matches the user ID.
